fallbackVisible.scope: Cached selected entries for current liveEnemySelection/liveCorpseSelection only. Renderer exposes no enumerable selection ID list for all other baked/fallback-visible actors.

originalReadback.note: QA-owned original Renderer read diagnostic only. R0 is the caller's previously captured main RGBA array. R1 is read before hashes, metadata or Canvas state inspection; a differing R1 stops before any floor observation or R2. If requested, F reads the original source-created, already cached floor using getContext("2d") without options, then R2 reads the same main context. No tick, render, await, export, drawing, state setter, wrapper, new surface or asset is added. A floor read can itself materialize backing storage. Native function/brand observations and context attributes do not identify a GPU/backend or prove its behavior. State is inspected after the read sequence; no pre-read state snapshot or invisible clip/path equivalence is claimed. Hashes are bounded noncryptographic byte fingerprints, not source authenticity. This is neither a timing/performance acceptance nor presented FPS evidence. Any later PNG export is separate from R0 and cannot certify the exact R0 bytes.

report.note: Explicit own-data originalReadbackProbe:true and exact qa-original-readback=1: two fresh ORIGINAL arms, no candidate installer, preparation experiment or profiler. Keep the original final whole Canvas R0 and strict AA gate. Immediately reread the unchanged main Canvas R1; stop on any difference. Only stable R1 permits reading the existing floor F followed by unchanged main R2. No added render, simulation tick, pose selection or await between these reads. Floor read may flush/materialize its backing; it does not certify pre-blit floor pixels. Postprobe PNG is separate evidence, not certified to equal primary R0. Extra reads are quality diagnostics and all timings are ineligible as optimization evidence. 8851 genuine-memory QA only. Fresh owned Renderer/Art/native player and initial max-three-model NPC preparation per original/manual/original arm. Original on-demand species loads remain enabled; actual runtime model/pending maxima are reported. Main ready records are borrowed by identity and never loaded, masked or released through a mutating path. Forty fixed .12-second catch-up callbacks include their first draw; batch-eight rAF yields are reported separately. This is a renderer combat harness without app HUD, audio or persistence, not presented FPS. Certification and lifecycle wrappers are inside render timing in every arm; no Canvas-stage, native-stage or frame-cost observer is installed. Literal per-frame checkpoint/effects/motion/commands/events and both RNG states are compared outside timers. Final whole-canvas readback and PNG export follow the measured loop. Existing twelve-state/two-selected-cell pixel QA is separate evidence, not proof for every source frame. Shared URL decode caches and the live product caches remain resident; fresh instances do not imply cold driver/URL caches. Owned native pending promises are followed through late success/failure for retirement. A failed player Promise.all can have unobservable sibling requests; that failure is explicitly cleanup-unproven rather than called complete. Timings are CPU call wall, not GPU duration or peak memory. No product optimization is adopted by this utility.

readbackStorage.note: Two original final-canvas arrays and at most two PNG strings; raw arrays are dropped after strict AA comparison. Not a peak-memory measurement.
